data.name: Rahim
data.gender_notes: Rahim is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ر-ح-م (r-ḥ-m), 'to have mercy'. Raḥīm means 'merciful'. Its root is ر-ح-م (r-ḥ-m). One of the 99 names of Allah (al-Raḥīm). Rahim is a Arabic name meaning “Merciful; compassionate”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rahim expresses “Merciful; compassionate”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ر-ح-م (r-ḥ-m), 'to have mercy'. Raḥīm means 'merciful'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rahim total 31, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
